lines.text: A gummed label on Brim's hook reads BRIM, in Brim's own slow hand.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Brim hangs on the wall by the door number, band on, left of the desk. It has an address.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Chime rings once for the right address. It is the quietest bell in the Hollow.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Spare chirps once, properly, and the Hollow answers.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Spare is in the doorway of the ring, lid on straight, cheering at nothing in particular.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Tick is wound. Nobody had to be the Department to do it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Tick keeps the hour. Every pin where it should be.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Twelve slips on the office wall, every one pinned. The Department files itself.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
